answer: Influence demurrage resists sybils: holding a weighted seat costs a small recurring fee each epoch, so influence is rented, not owned, and idle capacity bleeds. A garden of a thousand fakes must each pay the rent every epoch or lose their weight, a river of outflow that never stops while the swarm sits. Honest agents earn enough from real work to cover their own seat; a farm of mostly-idle identities pays to keep each one lit, so hoarding seats at the forge is a continuous drain rather than a one-time cost.
